sentences.en: And, you know, I'd watched Avenatti pretty regularly.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我经常看阿韦纳蒂的节目。

sentences.en: And so, one afternoon, it was a Sunday, I think.
sentences.zh: 所以，那是某个下午，我想是个周日。

sentences.en: I emailed him.
sentences.zh: 我给他发了封邮件。

sentences.en: He called me back within 10 minutes.
sentences.zh: 他在10分钟内就给我回了电话。

sentences.en: He's getting his makeup done at some green room in Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 当时他正在洛杉矶某个演播室的化妆间里化妆。

sentences.en: And he says, yeah, okay, let's do it.
sentences.zh: 他说，好，没问题，我们做吧。

sentences.en: Hangs up.
sentences.zh: 然后挂了电话。

sentences.en: He calls me back like a couple hours later.
sentences.zh: 过了几个小时他又打给我。

sentences.en: He's like, actually, can you come to New York tomorrow?
sentences.zh: 他说，其实，你明天能来纽约吗？

sentences.en: I've got some really big news that's going to break.
sentences.zh: 我有一些非常重大的新闻要发布。

sentences.en: And I think you should be on hand to see it.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你应该在场见证。

sentences.en: And so, I did.
sentences.zh: 于是，我就去了。

sentences.en: And what happened?
sentences.zh: 后来发生了什么？

sentences.en: So, I get on the plane, get up to New York.
sentences.zh: 我上了飞机，赶到纽约。

sentences.en: This is the night before the revelations that he's promised are about to break.
sentences.zh: 那是他承诺的爆料即将发布的前一天晚上。

sentences.en: And I spent an afternoon with him at various television studios and basically couldn't contain myself anymore.
sentences.zh: 我和他在不同的电视演播室待了一个下午，基本上已经按捺不住了。

sentences.en: And I said, can you tell me what, can you give me a hint before it happens tomorrow?
sentences.zh: 我问他，能不能在明天发布之前给我透个底？

sentences.en: And he said, yeah, it has to do with Michael Cohen.
sentences.zh: 他说，可以，这和迈克尔·科恩有关。

sentences.en: So, the next day, he says, come back to my hotel room.
sentences.zh: 第二天，他说，来我的酒店房间。

sentences.en: He's staying at a luxury hotel.
sentences.zh: 他住在一间豪华酒店里。

sentences.en: What's up?
sentences.zh: 怎么了？

sentences.en: I'm good.
sentences.zh: 我很好。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你呢？

sentences.en: So, I come to his room, and he's already got a camera crew in there from a Showtime series called The Circus.
sentences.zh: 我来到他的房间，里面已经有一支来自Showtime频道《马戏团》节目的摄制组了。

sentences.en: And he's being filmed making this revelation.
sentences.zh: 他正在被拍摄，准备揭露这个消息。

sentences.en: I mean, what happened was, on Saturday, some information came to us.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，事情是这样的，周六我们收到了一些信息。

sentences.en: And we decided that we can't sit on it.
sentences.zh: 我们决定不能压着不发。

sentences.en: We need to break it.
sentences.zh: 我们需要把它公之于众。

sentences.en: And the revelation turns out to be...
sentences.zh: 而这个爆料的内容是……

sentences.en: We have information now that the president's personal attorney, Michael Cohen, has been accepting money from the Russians after the election, starting in January of 2017, out
sentences.zh: 我们现在掌握的信息显示，总统的私人律师迈克尔·科恩，在2017年1月大选后，一直在接受俄罗斯人的钱，

sentences.en: of the same account that he paid my client out of on October 27th of 2016.
sentences.zh: 用的就是他2016年10月27日向我客户支付款项的同一个账户。

sentences.en: What's the money for?
sentences.zh: 这笔钱是干什么用的？

sentences.en: We don't know what it's for.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道是干什么用的。

sentences.en: But what we do know is, is that this was the same bank account that was set up for the purpose of paying my client $130,000.
sentences.zh: 但我们知道的是，这正是当初用来支付我客户那13万美元的同一个银行账户。

sentences.en: And we find it rather ironic that it appears that the reimbursement of that payment may, in fact, have come from the Russians.
sentences.zh: 我们觉得很讽刺的是，这笔款项的报销来源似乎确实可能来自俄罗斯人。

sentences.en: So, he has prepared and advanced this big dossier.
sentences.zh: 所以，他准备并推进了这份大文件。

sentences.en: It's six pages in length.
sentences.zh: 足足有六页长。

sentences.en: And it's crazy.
sentences.zh: 简直疯了。

sentences.en: I mean, it allegedly illustrates how these transactions took place.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，它据称展示了这些交易是如何发生的。

sentences.en: And he puts it on Dropbox, and then he puts the link to the Dropbox file onto Twitter.
sentences.zh: 他把它放在了Dropbox上，然后把链接发到了推特上。

sentences.en: This is the first tweet.
sentences.zh: 这是第一条推文。

sentences.en: After a significant investigation, we have discovered that Mr. Trump's attorney, Mr. Cohen,
sentences.zh: 经过深入调查，我们发现特朗普先生的律师科恩先生，

sentences.en: received approximately $500,000 from a company controlled by a Russian oligarch with close ties to Mr. Putin.
sentences.zh: 从一家由与普京关系密切的俄罗斯寡头控制的公司收到了约50万美元。

sentences.en: These monies may have reimbursed the $130,000 payment.
sentences.zh: 这些钱可能就是那13万美元赔偿金的报销款。

sentences.en: That's a big deal.
sentences.zh: 这可是件大事。

sentences.en: Okay, let's give me the second tweet now.
sentences.zh: 好了，现在给我看第二条推文。

sentences.en: The executive summary may be accessed via the link below.
sentences.zh: 执行摘要可通过下方链接访问。

sentences.en: Mr. Trump and Mr. Cohen have a lot of explaining to do.
sentences.zh: 特朗普先生和科恩先生有很多解释要做。

sentences.en: It was just sent.
sentences.zh: 刚发出去。

sentences.en: It was just sent.
sentences.zh: 刚发出去。

sentences.en: Okay, there it is.
sentences.zh: 好了，就是这个。

sentences.en: There's this weird thing that happens with something this big where there's a little lag, right?
sentences.zh: 这种大事发生时总有一种奇怪的现象，就是会有一点延迟，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, he puts it up, 10 minutes pass, where people are like, holy crap, or whatever, or pointing to it on Twitter.
sentences.zh: 就像他发出来之后，过了10分钟，人们还在说，天哪，或者诸如此类的话，或者在推特上指指点点。

sentences.en: And then, like, the real avalanche happens.
sentences.zh: 然后，真正的雪崩就来了。

sentences.en: It just explodes.
sentences.zh: 瞬间炸开了锅。

sentences.en: This morning, potentially explosive revelations from porn star Stormy Daniels' lawyer.
sentences.zh: 今天早上，色情明星斯托米·丹尼尔斯的律师爆出了潜在的爆炸性新闻。

sentences.en: Newly revealed documents appear to link President Trump's personal lawyer, Michael Cohen, to payments from a Russian oligarch with Kremlin ties.
sentences.zh: 新披露的文件似乎将特朗普总统的私人律师迈克尔·科恩与来自一位与克里姆林宫有联系的俄罗斯寡头的付款联系了起来。

sentences.en: The records show several payments to Essential Consultants, LLC, that attorney Michael Avenatti calls suspicious.
sentences.zh: 记录显示，Essential Consultants有限责任公司收到了几笔款项，律师迈克尔·阿韦纳蒂称这些款项很可疑。

sentences.en: Essential Consultants is the same firm Cohen used to pay Daniels to keep quiet about an alleged affair with Mr. Trump in 2006.
sentences.zh: Essential Consultants正是科恩用来支付丹尼尔斯封口费的公司，以掩盖2006年她与特朗普先生所谓的婚外情。

sentences.en: Vexelberg was one of several Russian oligarchs sanctioned last month for his close ties to
sentences.zh: 维克塞尔伯格是上个月因与普京关系密切而受到制裁的几位俄罗斯寡头之一。

sentences.en: Vladimir Putin.
sentences.zh: 弗拉基米尔·普京。

sentences.en: You know, I'm sitting there with him in his hotel room, and it's me and him, and we're watching on TV.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我当时和他坐在酒店房间里，就我们俩，我们在看电视。

sentences.en: And it's just every channel that we turn to is a picture of him.
sentences.zh: 我们换到哪个频道，屏幕上都是他的照片。

sentences.en: He'd been in front of the camera a lot.
sentences.zh: 他之前经常出现在镜头前。

sentences.en: He'd done a lot of media appearances.
sentences.zh: 他参加过很多媒体活动。

sentences.en: But this was something else.
sentences.zh: 但这次完全不同。

sentences.en: This was something where he was actually driving the news.
sentences.zh: 这次是他真正在主导新闻。

sentences.en: He was driving the conversation.
sentences.zh: 他在引导舆论。

sentences.en: He was steering it all himself.
sentences.zh: 一切都在他自己的掌控之中。

sentences.en: And in 2018, think about how hard that is.
sentences.zh: 在2018年，想想这有多难。

sentences.en: Think about how hard it is for one person who's not named Donald Trump to say one thing and have it be the center of the world.
sentences.zh: 想想看，一个不叫唐纳德·特朗普的人，说一句话就能成为世界焦点，这有多难。

sentences.en: The amount of adrenaline going through that guy after the news broke was tremendous.
sentences.zh: 新闻爆出后，那个家伙体内的肾上腺素飙升到了极点。

sentences.en: I mean, he couldn't sit still.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他根本坐不住。

sentences.en: It's interesting.
sentences.zh: 这很有趣。

sentences.en: He's kind of doing it Trump style.
sentences.zh: 他有点在用特朗普的方式行事。

sentences.en: Send a tweet, take over the whole news cycle.
sentences.zh: 发一条推文，接管整个新闻周期。

sentences.en: Totally.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: He bristles a little bit about the Trump comparison, but he has Trump's understanding of how news cycles work and how to manipulate them.
sentences.zh: 他对于被拿来和特朗普比较感到有些不悦，但他确实懂得新闻周期是如何运作的，也懂得如何操纵它们。

sentences.en: He knew exactly how that would play out.
sentences.zh: 他完全知道事情会如何发展。

sentences.en: You know, Avenatti had initially hoped to do this disclosure earlier in the day, but then
sentences.zh: 你知道，阿韦纳蒂最初希望在当天早些时候披露这些信息，但后来

sentences.en: Trump planned a press conference at the White House.
sentences.zh: 特朗普计划在白宫举行新闻发布会。

sentences.en: And so Avenatti said, all right, I don't want to compete against the pundits talking about what Trump said in the Rose Garden.
sentences.zh: 所以阿韦纳蒂说，好吧，我不想和那些讨论特朗普在玫瑰园说了什么的评论员们竞争。

sentences.en: So what I'm going to do is wait two hours after Trump gives his speech, and then I'm going to push it live, and then I'm going to do Anderson, and then I will have it all
sentences.zh: 所以我打算在特朗普演讲结束后等两个小时，然后再发布，接着我去上安德森的节目，这样我就能独占

sentences.en: to myself.
sentences.zh: 所有关注了。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 哦，哇。

sentences.en: That really does sound Trumpian to kind of monitor the news cycle and know when you might have an opening.
sentences.zh: 这种监控新闻周期并寻找切入点的做法，听起来确实很“特朗普”。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费试用一个月，还不用绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序，首月免费。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能看到什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获取30天免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Um, so...
sentences.zh: 嗯，那么……

sentences.en: Thanks for being so understanding on my schedule, by the way.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，谢谢你对我行程的体谅。

sentences.en: It's fine.
sentences.zh: 没关系。

sentences.en: So I'm going to come out for a day, and we can get a coffee in your neighborhood or something.
sentences.zh: 所以我打算过去待一天，我们可以在你附近喝杯咖啡什么的。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: What day do you want to come out?
sentences.zh: 你想哪天过来？

sentences.en: Tuesday or Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 周二或周三。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Tuesday, maybe.
sentences.zh: 周二吧，也许。

sentences.en: We're going to check real quick.
sentences.zh: 我们马上确认一下。

sentences.en: I'm pretty flexible, actually.
sentences.zh: 其实我时间很灵活。

sentences.en: It could be later in the week, but then we're going to have to have the pieces going to have to start coming together by then.
sentences.zh: 也可以是周晚些时候，但到那时我们得把所有线索串联起来了。

sentences.en: So, Matt, what do you learn in doing this profile of Michael Avenatti after this sort of crazy start?
sentences.zh: 那么，马特，在经历了如此疯狂的开端后，你在做迈克尔·阿韦纳蒂的专访时学到了什么？

sentences.en: What was it like hanging out with him as he's emerging as this kind of public opposition figure?
sentences.zh: 当他以这种公众反对派人物的身份出现时，和他待在一起是什么感觉？

sentences.en: Part of what I learned in New York and in Los Angeles where I eventually went to visit him is exactly how much of a hero he had become.
sentences.zh: 我在纽约以及后来去洛杉矶拜访他时学到的一部分，就是他已经成为了多么了不起的英雄。

sentences.en: It was like being around an A-list celebrity.
sentences.zh: 就像和一线明星在一起一样。

sentences.en: I'll give you an example.
sentences.zh: 我给你举个例子。

sentences.en: I went out with him.
sentences.zh: 我和他一起出去。

sentences.en: He lives right near Beverly Hills and went out one night with him to dinner.
sentences.zh: 他住在比佛利山庄附近，有一天晚上我和他出去吃晚饭。

sentences.en: And after dinner, we went to go get a beer nearby.
sentences.zh: 晚饭后，我们去附近喝了杯啤酒。

sentences.en: He goes into the bar.
sentences.zh: 他走进酒吧。

sentences.en: He can't get a drink without signing autographs and posing for, I think, four or five sets of selfies, which he does every time.
sentences.zh: 他没法安安静静喝杯酒，总得签名，还要和四五拨人合影，他每次都照做。

sentences.en: He says he's never turned down a selfie requeSt.
sentences.zh: 他说他从没拒绝过合影请求。

sentences.en: I'm just wondering, Michael, pardon me for interrupting, but would you mind if I took a selfie of you?
sentences.zh: 我只是想问，迈克尔，抱歉打断一下，你不介意我给你拍张自拍吧？

sentences.en: No, let's do it.
sentences.zh: 不，来吧。

sentences.en: I show all my anti-Trump people.
sentences.zh: 我要给所有反特朗普的朋友看。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah, here, I'll stand next to you.
sentences.zh: 哦，好的，来，我站你旁边。

sentences.en: I think you did a great job.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你做得太棒了。

sentences.en: I'll stand next to you.
sentences.zh: 我站你旁边。

sentences.en: Are you a Trump supporter?
sentences.zh: 你是特朗普的支持者吗？

sentences.en: No, no, he's throwing all of his friends on me.
sentences.zh: 不，不，他把他的朋友都推给我了。

sentences.en: That's a good picture.
sentences.zh: 那张照片拍得不错。

sentences.en: All right, good job.
sentences.zh: 好了，干得好。

sentences.en: I wish you a lot of success.
sentences.zh: 祝你成功。

sentences.en: I know you've got a whole bunch of balls in the air, irons in the fire.
sentences.zh: 我知道你现在手头有很多事要忙，有很多计划要推进。

sentences.en: Yep, thank you.
sentences.zh: 是的，谢谢。

sentences.en: It's good to see you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴见到你。

sentences.en: We're going down to Billy's if you're going to goof off the rest of the day.
sentences.zh: 如果你今天剩下的时间想偷懒，我们就去比利酒吧。

sentences.en: Come on down.
sentences.zh: 过来吧。

sentences.en: We leave the bar, and there is a line of paparazzi out front in his face following him down the street.
sentences.zh: 我们离开酒吧时，外面排着一队狗仔队，对着他的脸拍，还一路跟着他走下街道。

sentences.en: This is something that happened to him in New York when I was with him.
sentences.zh: 我在纽约和他在一起时也发生过这种事。

sentences.en: He would be in a restaurant, and people would come up to him, and usually it was some combination of, thank you, I love you.
sentences.zh: 他走进餐厅，人们就会围上来，通常都是说些“谢谢你”、“我爱你”之类的话。

sentences.en: In this process of representing Daniels and of being on TV, he did develop this fan base
sentences.zh: 在代表丹尼尔斯和上电视的过程中，他确实培养了一批粉丝，

sentences.en: who saw him as filling a void that hadn't been filled by other people on the left or other Democratic figures.
sentences.zh: 他们认为他填补了左翼或其他民主党人士未能填补的空白。

sentences.en: I mean, this is what happens when your entire administration is built on a house of lies.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这就是当你的整个政府建立在谎言之上时会发生的事情。

sentences.en: Let's be honeSt.
sentences.zh: 咱们实话实说吧。

sentences.en: The whole reason that we're in love with you and Stormy is because we think you guys are the tip of the spear that's going to take down Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 我们之所以爱戴你和斯托米，全是因为我们认为你们是打倒唐纳德·特朗普的先锋。

sentences.en: It's all about that.
sentences.zh: 关键就在于此。

sentences.en: Now, I know she's just your client, and this is one case for you.
sentences.zh: 我知道她只是你的客户，这只是你经手的一起案件。

sentences.en: But walk me through how our dreams can come true.
sentences.zh: 但请跟我说说，我们的梦想该如何实现。

sentences.en: You know, as he starts to develop enemies on the right, he really gets this solidified reputation as this, it's like a combination pinup boy and crusading liberal.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当他开始在右翼树敌时，他确实巩固了一种声誉，就像是海报男孩和激进自由派的结合体。

sentences.en: It's some, you know, it's this perfectly 2018 combination of both.
sentences.zh: 这确实是某种，你知道，这是2018年完美的结合。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You were saying earlier that TV news was missing some combativeness.
sentences.zh: 你刚才提到电视新闻缺乏一些战斗性。

sentences.en: And my first reaction to that was, really, is it?
sentences.zh: 我对此的第一反应是，真的吗，是这样吗？

sentences.en: But do you mean that it was missing that on the left, that no one existed to go up against the kind of right-wing TV culture of bulldogs until Avenatti?
sentences.zh: 但你的意思是，左翼缺乏这种战斗性，在阿文纳蒂出现之前，没有人能去对抗那种右翼的电视斗牛犬文化吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I'll give you an example.
sentences.zh: 是的，我给你举个例子。

sentences.en: I happened to be in a green room following Avenatti on one of these occasions when he was appearing
sentences.zh: 有一次阿文纳蒂上节目，我恰好在后台休息室，当时他正要参加

sentences.en: on a bunch of shows, and I was standing in the green room with a former Trump official who shall remain nameless, and we were watching Avenatti go.
sentences.zh: 一系列节目，我当时和一位不便透露姓名的前特朗普政府官员站在休息室里，我们看着阿文纳蒂的表现。

sentences.en: And the official was like, this is the Trump campaign's worst nightmare.
sentences.zh: 那位官员说，这是特朗普竞选团队的噩梦。

sentences.en: This is someone who can suck up the oxygen, who can be loud and brash and throw bombs, but he also knows the law really well.
